answer: The protocol posts D, the sum of missing seals below quorum K on every open assignment. A submit burns D units of this epoch's per-head payout, bound to that key and struck at close. A lone head facing a hollow trellis of 20 missing seals burns 20. Each extra identity adds K to D, so the tenth pays 20+9K and a farm of n pays n*20+K*n(n-1)/2. D is network-global: a fresh key cannot reset, split, or pre-age it; parallel posts serialize in inclusion order. Refuse the burn and the submit is dropped. One sonnet costs one D; the next fake costs more.
